title: "Close enough?" An investigation into multiplication errors in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.38634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently fail at multi-digit arithmetic, but the underlying mechanisms governing these failures remain poorly understood. While recent work demonstrates that addition errors follow a "noisy quantisation" model localised around carry boundaries, whether this framework generalises to multiplication remains an open question. In this work, we evaluate multiplication capabilities across several small base LLMs on a dataset of 16,991 problems spanning varied operand lengths. We show that multiplication errors do not conform to the addition-style noisy quantisation model. Instead, we uncover a novel error regime in small Qwen models: errors in lower-order columns predominantly preserve parity. Conversely, higher-order digit errors shift toward off-by-one carry failures. Our findings suggest that arithmetic computation in LLMs relies on distinct, multi-periodic internal representations where parity is tracked more

translated_title: “足够接近吗？”——对大语言模型中乘法错误的调查研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在多位数算术运算中经常出错，但导致这些失败的底层机制仍然知之甚少。尽管近期研究表明加法错误遵循一种局部化于进位边界附近的“噪声量化”模型，但该框架是否同样适用于乘法仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在这项工作中，我们在一个包含16,991道题目、覆盖不同操作数长度的数据集上评估了多个小型基础LLM的乘法能力。我们发现乘法错误并不符合加法式的噪声量化模型。相反，我们在小型Qwen模型中发现了一种新颖的错误模式：低阶列的错误主要保持奇偶性不变，而高阶数字错误则偏向于差一的进位失败。我们的发现表明，LLM中的算术计算依赖于独特的多周期内部表示，其中奇偶性受到更密切的跟踪。
tldr: 该研究发现小型大语言模型的乘法错误并不遵循加法的“噪声量化”模型，而是呈现低阶错误保持奇偶性、高阶错误偏向差一进位失败的新模式，表明LLM的算术计算依赖多周期的内部表示机制。
en_tdlr: This study shows that multiplication errors in small LLMs do not follow the addition-style "noisy quantisation" model; instead, low-order errors predominantly preserve parity while high-order errors shift toward off-by-one carry failures, suggesting LLMs rely on distinct multi-periodic internal representations for arithmetic.
